notes: Group: Everything Else (LIGHT SIDE). COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1099 crop) on the Defensive Shield frame (blue with the red fade at the upper right and lower right, as the VS shield slips). (2) LORE BOX: '“Et tu taka bu Jabba now.”' — same as the printed lore. Right of the lore box: the Jabba's Palace expansion ring (gold) and BELOW it a black EPISODE I icon, which the printed card does NOT have → ring_icons ['episode1'] (slip addition). (3) ART WINDOW blank white; no copyright printed (stays from the printed card). (4) Banner DEFENSIVE SHIELD; game text 4 lines; no icon column; VS16 set sphere at the bottom right. Not a tall slip: banner and text box at the printed card's heights (checked by overlaying the scan). (5) Bottom strip: caption '•You Will Take Me To Jabba Now (V)', number 37; heading '•Simple Tricks And Nonsense (V)'.
